close_reason: Added a parallel realistic-demo-ids section to both src/lib.rs //! crate-level rustdoc and README.md (sibling to the existing 'memory' feature section). Both copies explain: the default deterministic id format and its two known bugs (recycle-after-destroy, reset-on-process-restart), what the feature flip changes (process-global timestamp+counter minter matching canonical jmap-mail-server's email.rs:1748 pattern, survives deletes, lex-orderable within a process, NOT repeatable across runs), and the workspace-wide implication that a downstream Cargo feature unification can flip the id format for every MemoryBackend in the build. Commit 1f0ac84.
description:
Cargo.toml:21-28 declares a 'realistic-demo-ids' feature. The doc comment in Cargo.toml explains the toggle. But:

- lib.rs does not mention realistic-demo-ids in its //! crate-level rustdoc (lib.rs:1-29 documents only the memory feature).
- README.md does not mention it either.
- Only demo_next_id's body comment (memory.rs:253-313) explains the behavior.

A user reading the README or rustdoc sees: 'memory' (documented), 'realistic-demo-ids' (invisible). Worse: enabling realistic-demo-ids changes the id format for all backends generated from the same workspace build, so a downstream consumer using MemoryBackend in their test suite who accidentally enables realistic-demo-ids via their own Cargo features will see test output change (deterministic '00000000...' → process-start-timestamp) with no doc trail.

The exact same pattern was flagged as bd:JMAP-x2gd.63 against chat-server. This is the metadata-server propagation of the same issue.

Fix: add a short paragraph to the lib.rs //! block AND README.md 'memory feature' section explaining what realistic-demo-ids does and when to use it. Cross-reference the canonical jmap-mail-server demo_next_id pattern.

Severity: P4 because the feature is opt-in and the failure mode is 'test fixtures look different across feature flips', not anything user-visible at runtime. Documenting it costs nothing and avoids a class of 'why did my snapshot test break' bug reports.
title: Cargo.toml feature 'realistic-demo-ids' is undocumented in lib.rs and README
